capabilities: Import Zotero sources, notes, and highlights as literature notes with links back to Zotero
Sync imported source material with personal and group Zotero libraries and collections
Compose citations in CSL styles (APA, IEEE, Chicago Notes) and generate bibliographies
Compare sources in tables using metadata and recorded research properties
Create PDFs of papers with layout options using Pandoc and Tectonic
extras: Cloud imports go through Stratum's own service; bulk sync and PDF publishing are desktop-only; publishing templates download from templates.stratumnotes.com; the plugin states it has no telemetry and does not upload drafts or personal writing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull in Zotero sources, manage citations in multiple styles, or produce a cited paper as a PDF.

relations.evidence: Select Connect Zotero and approve access to your Zotero account.
available OpenAlex data adds context such as citation counts, open access links, and retraction flags

summary: Zotero integration that imports sources as literature notes, syncs them, and supports citation writing and PDF publishing in Obsidian.
